deskyard: use a Deskyard desktop (a Linux desktop with a shared browser) from inside it or from anywhere else.

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] COMMAND [ARGS...]

New here? Run `deskyard guide` (written for AI agents) and `deskyard COMMAND --help`.

Desktop (screen, mouse, keyboard):
  screenshot [FILE|-]                  PNG of the whole screen
  zoom X0 Y0 X1 Y1 [FILE|-]            PNG of a region at full resolution
  size                                 print the screen size
  cursor                               print the mouse position
  move X Y                             move the mouse
  click X Y [left|right|middle]        click at X Y
  double-click X Y                     double left-click at X Y
  triple-click X Y                     triple left-click at X Y
  mouse-down [left|right|middle]       press a mouse button
  mouse-up [left|right|middle]         release a mouse button
  drag X1 Y1 X2 Y2                     left-drag from one point to another
  type TEXT...                         type text into the focused window
  key COMBO...                         press keys or shortcuts
  hold-key KEY SECONDS                 hold a key down for a while
  scroll X Y up|down|left|right [N]    scroll at X Y
  wait SECONDS                         pause for a while

Shell and files:
  exec [OPTIONS] -- CMD [ARG...]       run a command on the desktop
  terminal [SESSION]                   join a shared terminal session
  shell                                interactive login shell
  cp SRC DST                           copy files to or from a desktop
  forward [-R] PORT[:PORT]...          map TCP ports between this machine and the desktop

Browser:
  browser connect [--port N]           forward the desktop's browser to a local CDP port

Remotes:
  remote add NAME URL --token dyt_…    save a desktop as a remote
  remote list [--json]                 list saved remotes
  remote remove NAME                   forget a remote
  remote default [NAME]                set or show the default remote

Information:
  status [--json]                      show the desktop's name, state, image and screen
  guide                                short manual for AI agents
  describe --json                      machine-readable description of every command
  help [COMMAND...]                    help for a command
  version                              print the version

Choosing a desktop:
  Inside a desktop, commands act on it directly. Elsewhere they use a remote:
  -d NAME, else $DESKYARD_REMOTE, else $DESKYARD_URL + $DESKYARD_TOKEN,
  else the default remote (`deskyard remote default`).

Environment:
  DESKYARD_REMOTE  remote to use when -d isn't given
  DESKYARD_URL     desktop URL (https://host/alice) to use without a remotes.json; needs DESKYARD_TOKEN
  DESKYARD_TOKEN   agent token for DESKYARD_URL, and the default for `remote add --token`
  DESKYARD_SETTLE  seconds screenshot and zoom wait before capturing (default 0.3)
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME  where remotes.json lives (default ~/.config)

Exit codes:
  0      ok
  1      error (the message on stderr says what to do next)
  2      usage error (bad command, flag or argument)
  other  exec, shell and screen actions pass through the exit code of the command on the desktop

Machine-readable: deskyard describe --json
